title: Rejected records in an accepted body raise record drift once per episode; only a clean body with a newer stamp closes it; restart keeps the episode open
notes: The damaged ALTK04 2691 and ALTEF3 3754 records are the real records with their first header line renamed; they are synthetic.

Steps 6 and 7 model an edge alternating between the step 1 and step 2 bodies. Both have the stamp 19:38, because a rejected record does not count towards it, so each is 'updated'. The clean step 1 body is not newer than the episode, so it does not close it, and step 7 raises nothing.

Step 9 is clean and newer, so it closes the episode. Step 10 serves the step 8 body again. Its stamp, 19:38, is older than last-known-good's 19:39, so it is a 'stale-snapshot' and neither raises, closes nor advances the episode. Step 11 opens a new one. Step 12 serves the step 9 body again at the same stamp and does not close it.
